module Matrix.QualifiedContract

function normalize(amount: Integer) returns Integer
is
    return amount + 1
end normalize

function next(amount: Integer) returns Integer
requires Matrix.QualifiedContract.normalize(amount) > amount
ensures result = Matrix.QualifiedContract.normalize(amount)
is
    return Matrix.QualifiedContract.normalize(amount)
end next

end Matrix.QualifiedContract
